item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (64)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 64

  • Frames from the same moment stay in one scene, and the sharpest comes first
  • A box marks the sharpest area of each photo
  • Find sharpest has its own button, and a folder’s Get Info shows where it is and how big it is
